log: Act III, W4: the Flutlichtung, from the forest path through the clearing and back; a run from here has no Act I, II or morning behind it
the first ring on the forest path: a fire and tea (the first rest sets the facet care, which the tea at the trunk reads)
the door at the end of the path: the clearing, and the Antreiber has gone on ahead
the trail of one runner in the dry silt, going north
the bleached trunk without a crown, the band of silt over her head: the goal of the way
the Antreiber at the trunk, measuring; with care the first answer is the tea, and he sits on the ground
spoken to again, sitting: one short line and one answer
the camp the silt took: ring, kettle, and the blanket with one red stroke
the empty nest in the grass at the west rim, taken with the first answer
the forked branch at the water: the nest goes into the fork
the driftwood on the bank, put in her pocket
the flat stones across the brook: a trace of the world
back through the door to the forest path
